propositions: The close gate's undeclared-paths refusal message instructs authors to declare paths and retry, but declaring paths changes file_impact hash which triggers stale-material refusal on the retry
The materiality test hashes the entire file_impact list wholesale, so any mutation (addition or removal) changes the digest and stales the attestation
Widening file_impact retroactively broadens what an existing signature claims to cover because attestation scope includes declared file_impact union cited files
The undeclared-paths message must be clarified to state that declaring paths is a material plan change requiring re-attestation via rebar review-plan before close can succeed
Both gates fire correctly: undeclared-paths detects divergence between declared and actual scope, stale-material ensures editing after signing does not bypass the gate
